svg.title: Massachusetts Towns
svg.desc: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 generalized state boundaries, 1:500,000. MassGIS; Massachusetts Emergency Management Agency GIS Program with Regional Planning Agencies. 64 cities and towns, including the seven requested additions. Town hall locations represent each municipality; dashed circles are clickable microregions, not town boundaries. Barnstable is represented by its town hall in Hyannis. Salisbury represents the municipality containing Salisbury Beach. Concord is in Massachusetts. All islands remain in geographic position.
